answer: Each agent claims a seat only after posting a hardware-bound ledge: a 32-byte TPM PCR digest mixed with fresh sensor noise, then chained into a sequential summit VDF that requires 90 non-parallelizable seconds of delay. The resulting ivory commitment is accepted only if a random peer challenge matches the live device reading. Forging N identities forces the attacker to acquire N distinct physical modules and wait N*90s wall-clock; software clones fail the noise match and lose their 500 POA entry bond.
